purpose: Complete approval-preserving automatic enforcement of supported GitHub write paths, race-safe branch-ref updates, and durable pending failure evidence without automatic adoption or release.

write_boundary: Use new tree + one-parent commit based on approved expected HEAD, then non-force ref update; no Contents PUT for this approved operation path.
Immediately before write confirm account, approval provenance, exact candidate hash and file scope, current main/branch and Ruleset.
Conflict, timeout, missing response or unknown outcome: fail closed, read-only reconcile and never blindly retry.
Read-after-write must compare exact committed blob bytes; no authorized update to main or cb6-v2-clean.
failure_capture: Trusted default-branch code only, no checkout or execution of untrusted PR head, least-privilege GitHub token.
Observe only explicitly selected failures; redact tokens and unverified diagnostics.
Idempotency key binds workflow run ID, attempt, job ID and failure code; duplicate deliveries never create duplicate records.
Persist append-only pending evidence to an owner-approved dedicated GitHub issue or equivalent durable record only after explicit approval of that automation.
Never assert root cause verified or append to authoritative failures_v1.json automatically; owner approves any adoption.
route_enforcement: Inventory GitHub App, GitHub CLI, Actions token, branch rulesets, local git and merge/update/delete paths.
A code-level opt-in wrapper alone is insufficient; complete only after owner-authorized repository permissions and ruleset enforcement are verified.
Preserve Ruleset 24792110; propose any additional ruleset only as a separate exact owner-approved administrative change.
Explicitly state any owner-admin override or ungoverned credential remaining; never label all routes protected without evidence.

scope_tests_new_only: Approved exact parent commit + non-force ref update and exact committed bytes PASS.
Concurrent HEAD advancement, permission denial, 409/422, timeout, unknown PUT/patch outcome all BLOCK; no implicit retry.
Wrong actor, stale main, modified comment, wrong blob, Ruleset mismatch all BLOCK.
Failure ingestion: verified run metadata, idempotent duplicates, missing evidence, redacted secrets, untrusted event, ledger write forbidden.
One isolated authenticated write/negative validation only after new separate owner approval; never rerun existing PASS suites.
authorization_sequence: Create isolated proposal against fixed basis; no writes on the basis of this local plan alone.
Commit exact canonical plan first only after specific owner approval of that single planning write.
Bind owner-authored unedited GitHub approval to plan SHA, commit SHA, main and seven-file scope before code writes.
Implement isolated delta, run only new tests, obtain separate-GPT independent delta review and trusted Required Check.
Merge only after another explicit owner authorization and live immutable checks.
Any administrative ruleset/permission change and controlled live write test require their own approval and rollback plan.
completion_criteria: Protected branches and supported write paths confirmed against configured GitHub policies.
Approved Git ref update succeeds once; stale/concurrent updates fail without overwriting.
New failed run automatically creates one durable pending record, no secrets, duplicates or auto-adoption.
Any unprotected routes or admin override are disclosed instead of claiming completeness.
No Release, APK, Registry change, Method Freeze change or unapproved Actions dispatch.
